Decisions

Why things are the way they are. Records are never rewritten; superseded ones are marked.

On this page
  • D01. Open files with a hook, not skill instructions
  • D02. Allowlist, and no HTML by default
  • D03. Snippets are numbered project files
  • D04. Re-open on edit approximated by a session record

Each record is ## Dnn. Title followed by Context, Decision, Why and Consequences paragraphs. When a decision is reversed, add Status: superseded by Dmm directly under its heading and write the new record; do not edit the old text. IDs are never reused.

D01. Open files with a hook, not skill instructions

Context: Output must open automatically; Claude is unreliable at remembering to. Decision: A PostToolUse hook on Write|Edit opens allowlisted files. Pasteable text is saved as a snippet file so the same hook opens it. Why: Deterministic for files; one mechanism for both output kinds. Consequences: Only text that becomes a file is opened; Claude must choose to write snippets.

D02. Allowlist, and no HTML by default

Context: Claude writes many files, and source code must never pop open. Decision: Open only files matching an allow glob (docs markdown, snippets, README, specs, plans); deny generated files. HTML is not allowed by default (user's call). Why: Predictable, tunable per project. Consequences: Projects wanting HTML opened add it in .pastey.toml.

D03. Snippets are numbered project files

Context: Copy/paste text needs a home that supports highlighting and history. Decision: snippets/NNNN-meaningful-name.<ext> inside the project, kept. Why: User wants history and the snippets are useful artifacts (user's call). Consequences: snippets/ grows; projects may gitignore it if they prefer.

D04. Re-open on edit approximated by a session record

Context: The editor CLI cannot report which tabs are open. Decision: Open on create; on edit, open only if not yet opened this session. Why: Avoids stealing focus on every edit. Consequences: A tab closed mid-session stays closed until the next session.
